claim_boundary: Source-only feasibility audit on repetitions 1 and 2 of the public Tracking Cloth self-collision factorial. The three terminal alternatives are the physically executed release configurations. Recorded monotone timestamps are authoritative and are resampled to a registered 30 Hz analysis grid; the nominal capture rate is not assumed to be an exact timestamp lattice. Interaction prefixes are evaluated only as resettable block-level probe surrogates. Repetition 3 remains numerically unopened and no target protocol is authorized. This result cannot establish held-out physical-action benefit, online sensing, reset fidelity, unseen-material transfer, calibrated action loss, closed-loop robot control, deployment safety, or state of the art.
